title: Gate high-risk AI issue creation behind human approval evidence
spec: The AI helper CLI can turn a PM brief into GitHub issues and apply them directly. Today the apply path treats all issues alike, so an AI-classified high-risk issue (security/data/privacy, billing/cost, local execution, roadmap-changing, or release/deploy impact) can be created with no human sign-off. Change the issue-tree apply path so high-risk issue creation is blocked unless explicit human approval evidence is supplied (a flag with a reason, or an environment variable), the approval reason is recorded in the created issue body, and the CLI self-check covers both the blocked and approved paths.
